block: # Configurable FPGA fields, extracted from Form1.cs of "SAMPA communicator".
# reg   : register index inside the block (the same one the GUI uses)
# pos   : lowest bit of the field
name: bits: width of the field
command
description: Command: 2=SAMPA reset, 3=event trigger, 4=heartbeat, 5=bunch-crossing sync, 7=clear shiftreg errors

name: pulse_low
description: Cycles the pulse generator stays low (0 = off)

name: pulse_shift
description: Fine pulse shift, in SO clock periods

name: shiftreg_enable
description: Enable the shift register / continuous memory test

name: sampa_clk_stop
description: Stop the SAMPA clock (for slow-clock mode)

name: serial_enable
description: Enable mask for the 11 serial links (bit 0 = link 0)

name: das_enable
description: Enable DAS mode (exclusive with the serial links)

name: edge_select
description: Sampling edge of each link (1 bit per link)

name: edge_delay
description: Delay of each link, normally the inverse of edge_select
